Chapter 800: Chapter 16: Three Hundred Years Later (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 800: Chapter 16: Three Hundred Years Later (Subscription Requested)

Lin Yuan’s true body was stationed at the Tianqing World headquarters, while the two Primordial Spirits set out to explore separately.

This was the safest method.

Both the Taiyang Divine Spirit and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit were nearly as strong in combat power as Lin Yuan’s true body.

Even if they were to perish, the true self could condense them with a single thought.

There was nothing more secure.

Though the layers of the Boundless Void were inferior to the Main Universe,...

Lin Yuan never underestimated them, at least the Ninth Stage Evil Gods, in legend, could pose a slight threat to him.

Whoosh.

Whoosh.

Under Lin Yuan’s watchful eyes.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit immediately departed from the Tianqing World. … “Void Secret Realm?”

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit, following the coordinates on the scroll, swiftly headed towards the location of the Void Secret Realm.

With Lin Yuan’s mastery over space and time, the distance from the Tianqing World to the entrance of the Void Secret Realm, which took the Black Demon Pavilion Master five or six days to fly, Lin Yuan covered in just under half an incense stick’s time. “The Void Secret Realm, even the memories of entering the realm are shrouded and cannot be transmitted outward; what exactly is this place?”

Lin Yuan was curious.

The civilizations of the Main Universe could achieve similar feats, but human civilization was attended by nine Supreme Beings. “Also, what benefits can be gained from killing Void Creatures?”

The information within the scroll did not mention benefits, but Lin Yuan surmised there must be some. “Is it the physical bodies of the Void Creatures themselves, some form of material treasure?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This was the most natural conjecture, just as Lin Yuan could study the physical body of an Evil God when killed, the bodies of Void Creatures could similarly be studied.

Soon.

Lin Yuan came to a stop.

We’re here.”

Lin Yuan gazed into the vastness ahead.

But from the outside, the void in front appeared no different from the void elsewhere.

Yet Lin Yuan, relying on the scroll token, faintly sensed a mysterious space concealed deep within the void.

To be precise, it was the entrance to the mysterious space.

That is, the entrance to the Void Secret Realm. “This?”

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

Even without relying on the scroll token, with Lin Yuan’s space-time perception, he could detect the existence of the Void Secret Realm.

The more this was so, the more solemn Lin Yuan felt.

He could sense that the vastness of the Void Secret Realm was almost another Spatial Layer of the Boundless Void.

And the ‘entrance’ before him was just one of the many entrances to the Void Secret Realm.

Just like the Xuanhuang Secret Realm in the Main World, this Void Secret Realm likely had many entrances. “If it weren’t for this scroll token, I wouldn’t be able to enter.”

Lin Yuan thought, “I guess only those in the Five-Layered Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rules can enter the Void Secret Realm without a token.”

Lin Yuan was astonished. “Then the being who first opened this secret realm, how profound must their mastery of the fusion rules of space-time have been? Sixth Realm? The realm of Supreme Beings?”

Lin Yuan dared not hold any contempt.

Although many secret realms are naturally formed, this Void Secret Realm, since it has formed a scene of entering directly with a token, definitely involves artificial factors. “Let’s go in and see.”

Lin Yuan immediately activated the scroll, and suddenly a pulling force emerged from the depths of the void, bringing Lin Yuan inside.

If it were his true self, Lin Yuan would naturally not dare to enter an unknown secret realm so easily, but merely a Taiyang Primordial Spirit naturally could afford to take risks and explore.

Hum.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan found himself in a vast space.

Seeing no end in any direction, black mist occasionally hung in the sky. “This is the Void Secret Realm?”

Lin Yuan was very cautious, immediately hiding deep within the layers of space.

Inside the Void Secret Realm, it seemed like another Boundless Void, comprising many Spatial Layers. “Where are the Void Creatures?”

Lin Yuan looked around but saw no signs of any creature’s activity. “Let’s explore slowly.”

Lin Yuan began carefully selecting a direction to delve deeper. …

The Void Secret Realm was too vast, although Lin Yuan could traverse light-years in a single step when traveling, to search for Void Creatures, it needed to be done bit by bit; otherwise, if there were Void Creatures hidden within those light-years, they would go unnoticed.

A month after Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Primordial Spirit entered the Void Secret Realm.

Hum.

Lin Yuan moved swiftly, but from the outside, it didn’t cause any disturbance.

And tens of thousands of miles away, under a black mountain peak, a massive creature was eyeing Lin Yuan as he flew.

Lin Yuan’s true self hid within the many layers of space, yet this massive creature could clearly sense the aura of the many layers and pinpoint Lin Yuan’s location.

The massive creature slowly approached Lin Yuan.

Is that the Void Creature?”

While maintaining his movement, Lin Yuan had long noticed the massive creature that was approaching him.

With Lin Yuan’s perception, even without actively unfolding the world’s phantom, everything within billions of miles was as clear as observing patterns on one’s palm, and there was no possibility of being ambushed.

There is a marked difference from the Evil Gods.”

Lin Yuan secretly thought; the Void Creature he sensed felt no different from a wild beast, completely devoid of intellect, even its approach to conceal its presence was done by instinct.

Whereas with Evil Gods, although many of them occasionally went mad, they at least retained some intelligence.

Here it comes.”

A moment later, the massive creature had already approached within a hundred miles of Lin Yuan.

The next moment.

The massive creature stopped, no longer approaching. “Hmm?”

Lin Yuan did not strike immediately; instead, he wanted to see what tactics the void creatures possessed.

Humm.

An illusory world enveloped him, and Lin Yuan’s spirit will immediately fell into layer upon layer of illusions.

Before Lin Yuan’s eyes, the scene had changed; he was no longer in the Void Secret Realm but inside an imperial palace, where one enticing beauty after another approached, attempting to seduce him. “An illusionary realm?”

Lin Yuan was unconcerned. With his capabilities, he could easily fend off these illusions without the aid of any soul defense treasures. “Break.”

Lin Yuan’s thought turned into a sharp blade, effortlessly tearing through the illusionary world before him and returning to the outside world.

At that moment, the void creature was attempting to approach, hoping to strike while Lin Yuan was still trapped in the illusion.

However, Lin Yuan recovered too quickly. The void creature hadn’t even started to approach again when the so-called illusion was already over. “If it’s just illusionary tactics, then stay behind,” Lin Yuan said.

Knowing that this void creature posed no threat to his own strength, he directly attacked.

With a booming sound, the mighty power of the world surged forth, and the space itself subtly distorted. Before the void creature could react, it was captured in the palm of Lin Yuan’s hand.

This void creature was at least dozens of miles in size, but under the immense spatial suppression, it became the size of a pocket edition, continuously struggling in Lin Yuan’s palm. “Hmm?” “Unable to perform Soul Search? No specific memory images?”

Lin Yuan attempted to perform a Soul Search, but it was fruitless.

The thought processes of these void creatures were as chaotic as wild beasts; they couldn’t even store specific memories. “Just kill it then.”

After studying it for a while with no gains, Lin Yuan simply followed the information in the scroll and directly killed the void creature.

Humm.

At the moment of the void creature’s death.

Its physical body suddenly began to dematerialize. “This?”

Lin Yuan frowned.

The physical body disappeared upon death?

Not even leaving the body behind?

Then what’s the benefit of killing a void creature?

Before Lin Yuan could continue pondering, the completely dematerialized void creature dissipated into wisps of essence, which then merged into Lin Yuan’s body. “Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was about to activate the power of the world to expel these unknown essences, as they couldn’t be absorbed before their use was confirmed.

But even the power of the world couldn’t touch those few wisps of essence.

In an instant, the few wisps of essence disappeared inside Lin Yuan’s body. “Eh?”

Lin Yuan seemed to feel something, “Has my spirit will increased because of this void creature?”

Lin Yuan found it hard to believe.

There were only a few known ways to increase spirit will.

One was through the slow passage of ages.

Another was through enduring various tortures and pains.

For instance, when Lin Yuan delved into a body from a Supreme Being, enduring the omnipresent psychic will pressure, his own spirit will also slowly increased.

But such methods of increasing spirit will became increasingly ineffective as Lin Yuan’s own spirit will grew stronger.

But now?

Lin Yuan suddenly discovered that, after killing this void creature, his spirit will had actually increased markedly.

This was simply unimaginable.

The importance of spirit will goes without saying.

It is the core of the soul; the stronger the spirit will, the greater the enhancement to all aspects.

And to reach the Ultimate Realm, a strong spirit will is necessary; without it, one cannot withstand the backlash from the River of Time.

Most importantly, compared to other material treasures, an increase in spirit will can be directly taken back to the Main Universe.

After all, when Lin Yuan travels between worlds, his spirit will is his main form. When the traversal ends and he returns to the Main Universe, what goes back is also his spirit will.

And during this period, any enhancement of the spirit will can also be perfectly taken back. …

In the depths of Martial Hall in Tianqing World,

Lin Yuan, who was originally practicing and perceiving, suddenly opened his eyes. “My spirit will has indeed increased,” Lin Yuan exclaimed, his face revealing a flash of shock.

Armed with the vast compilations of information on human civilization from the Main Universe, he naturally knew how difficult it was to enhance spirit will.

According to the experiences summarized by human civilization, one of the many threshold conditions for Eleventh Rank powerhouses aiming for the Ultimate Realm is the spirit will index reaching ten million.

This is just the threshold; the higher the spirit will, the greater the aid in reaching the Ultimate Realm.

Previously, Lin Yuan was somewhat worried about how to increase his own spirit will.

Compared to special beings like the Four Divine Kings, Lin Yuan’s greatest disadvantage was being too young and having too short of a history, resulting in his spirit will lagging behind. “A great opportunity,” Lin Yuan murmured. “That Void Secret Realm, for me, is a great opportunity.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes heated slightly. “The main task of the Taiyang Divine Spirit in the Void Secret Realm is to find more void creatures and then kill them to enhance the spirit will,” he decided.

Lin Yuan quickly made a decision.

His true body would comprehend the Divine Skills Imprint ‘World’, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, and many other fusion rules.

As for the two Primordial Spirits… the Taiyang Primordial Spirit will focus on searching for void creatures.

Meanwhile, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, while searching through many worlds in the Boundless Void, will also comprehend various rules, etc.

Just like that, time quickly passed.

In the blink of an eye, three hundred years had passed.
